method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49493, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation number stated; compilation table ends with the Petroleum Legislation Amendment Act 2024 Pt 5 Div 13 (other than s 424(4)), in force 28 May 2026; last reprint listed is Reprint 11 as at 8 January 2016; no regulations used

checks.command: l4 run tla-cases-title.l4; l4 run tla-qa-cases.l4; l4 check tla-qa.l4
checks.result: tla-cases-title.l4: 70 of 70 assertions satisfied; tla-qa-cases.l4: 438 of 438 satisfied; 0 errors and 0 warnings in every file; l4 check tla-qa.l4 succeeds
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 52(2), 53, 58, 60, 61, 68, 88, 105, 105AA, 106-110, 113, 121-123, 131, 134, 138, 138A-138D, 139, 140, 142, 146, 148, 149, 187, 199, 201, 202, 211, 214A, 219, 220, 227: registration and the buyer's stay, indefeasibility and its exceptions, recovery and compensation, joint tenancy and no survivorship, the survivor's, executor's and devisee's routes onto the register, the mortgage and the mortgagor on default, sale, surplus and foreclosure, and caveats as they affect the owner
seat: the registered proprietor (owner, joint tenant or tenant in common, mortgagor) and the buyer

roles: I own registered land, or a share in it
I am the survivor, executor or a beneficiary of someone registered for land who has died
I lent money on a mortgage of someone's land
I claim an interest in someone's land and have lodged a caveat

situation_parameters.name: there is a mortgage over my land
questions: Am I bound by the mortgage over my land
May my mortgage be lodged electronically
What does my mortgage do to my title
Must I do this under my mortgage
Is my land free of the mortgage
How long must my default last before a notice to pay
May I be served a notice to pay
Was the notice to pay properly served on me
May my land be sold by my lender
How much of the sale money is mine
May my lender seek foreclosure
Can my land be foreclosed now

situation_parameters.name: I am in default under my mortgage
questions: May I be served a notice to pay
Was the notice to pay properly served on me
May my land be sold by my lender
How much of the sale money is mine
May my lender seek foreclosure
Can my land be foreclosed now

situation_parameters.name: a caveat has been lodged against my land
questions: Does the caveat block my dealing
Has the caveat lapsed on my application
Has the caveat lapsed on my 21-day notice
May the caveator caveat my land again
Can I be compensated for a caveat on my land

situation_parameters.name: I own the land with someone else
questions: Are my co-owner and I joint tenants
May we each take a certificate for our share
May I deal with our land despite no survivorship

situation_parameters.name: I have lost my land, or an interest in it, through fraud, error, misdescription or someone else's registration
questions: Can I recover damages from the State for my lost land
Is there still time to sue for my lost land

situation_parameters.name: someone holds or claims a lease of the land
questions: Do I hold my land subject to this lease
Is the tenant's option valid against me

situation_parameters.name: I take the land subject to a mortgage that stays on the title
questions: Must I indemnify the seller against the mortgage

situation_parameters.name: I am buying at a sale by a lender under its power of sale
questions: Do I buy free of this encumbrance

situation_parameters.name: my capacity
situation_parameters.does_not_arise: every value but the question's own: s 227 arises only for the surviving joint proprietor, s 187(1) and (3) only for the executor or administrator, s 220 only for a devisee under the will
questions: May I be registered as the survivor
Must I be registered as executor
May we executors deal with the land
May I be registered as the devisee

situation_parameters.name: the owner is in default under my mortgage
questions: May I serve a notice to pay
Is my notice to pay properly served
May I sell the mortgaged land
How much of the sale money must I pay the owner
May I apply to foreclose
May a foreclosure order issue to me

situation_parameters.name: I have been served with notice that the owner has applied to register a dealing
questions: Has my caveat lapsed on the owner's application

situation_parameters.name: the Registrar has served me with a notice that my caveat will lapse in 21 days
questions: Has my caveat lapsed on the 21-day notice

situation_parameters.name: my earlier caveat over this land has come to an end
questions: May I caveat the land again

qa_layer.site_note: The baseline's export 'How do I get onto the register after the death' also takes an input named 'my role' (the baseline's type 'Role', the capacity); the site's form sends it the seat's 'Seat' value and it fails for every seat. Not fixable in the layer; the layer's own question asks the capacity as 'my capacity'. See NOTES.md, Q&A layer, decision QA1.
